Symmetric cipher — A standalone encryption algorithm that provides confidentiality but not authentication (e.g., SPECK, CHACHA20).
AEAD suite — A combined construction offering both confidentiality and integrity protection, such as CHACHA20-Poly1305 or XTEA-Poly1305.
